topics.summary: Covers isolating members, choosing axes, and understanding what roller, pin, fixed, and internal hinge supports permit and restrain in 2D plane structures.

A horizontal force normal (perpendicular) to the vertical wall only

questions.prompt: When an internal frictionless pin (hinge) is introduced into a beam at point C, what additional condition equation does it provide for static analysis?
questions.assumptions: Used in Gerber beams and three-pinned arches/portals to render the structure statically determinate.
options: It redistributes the peak hogging bending moment into the adjacent midspan zone through rigid-plastic hinge rotation without requiring supplementary lateral-torsional restraint, web stiffeners, or ductile rotation capacity at the support interface
